keyVerseDR: "Blessed are the clean of heart: they shall see God." (Mt 5:8)

level1.title: Happy Are You
level1.story: Jesus taught on a mountain. He said, "Blessed are the poor, the gentle, and the peacemakers!" God makes them happy.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who did Jesus say is blessed?
level1.prayer: Jesus, make my heart pure and kind. Amen.

activity.title: Peacemaker badge
activity.intro: "Blessed are the peacemakers." Color your badge.
activity.label: Peacemaker

level2.title: The Beatitudes
level2.story: Jesus saw the crowds and went up the mountain to teach. He said, "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven." Blessed are those who mourn, the meek, and those who hunger for what is right. Blessed are the merciful, the clean of heart, and the peacemakers. Jesus said, "Rejoice and be glad, for your reward will be great in heaven."
level2.keyLine: Blessed are the clean of heart: they shall see God.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Which Beatitude is hardest for you?
Why are these the way to true happiness?
level2.prayer: Jesus, teach me the way of the Beatitudes. Amen.

activity.title: Blessed are...
activity.intro: Fill in the missing words of the Beatitude.
activity.text: Blessed are the [clean] of heart: they shall [see] God.
